	local t = {}
	local sum = 0

	for i = 0, #p1 - 2 do
		local v1 = p1[i + 2].X - p1[i + 1].X
		local v2 = p1[i + 2].Z - p1[i + 1].Z
		local v3 = math.sqrt(v1 * v1 + v2 * v2)

	end

	end

end

function v14.updateMinigame(p1, p2, p3) --[[ updateMinigame | Line: 1462 | Upvalues: DIG_CLICK_ENERGY_DECAY (copy), DIG_EFFECTIVE_CLICK_BURST (copy), DIG_EFFECTIVE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND (copy), TUTORIAL_PROGRESS_FLOOR (copy), DIG_INPUT_SEND_INTERVAL (copy), DIG_LOSE_THRESHOLD (copy), isDigImpossible (copy), Notification (copy) ]]
	local difficulty = p2.difficulty

	p2.clickEnergy = math.max(0, p2.clickEnergy - DIG_CLICK_ENERGY_DECAY * p3)
	p2.clickCredits = math.min(DIG_EFFECTIVE_CLICK_BURST, p2.clickCredits + DIG_EFFECTIVE_CLICKS_PER_SECOND * p3)

	if difficulty then
		p2.progress = math.max(0, p2.progress - difficulty.decay * p3)

		if p1.tutorial:isActive() then
			p2.progress = math.max(p2.progress, TUTORIAL_PROGRESS_FLOOR)
		end
	end

	local v6 = os.clock()

	if p2.totalClicks > 0 and DIG_INPUT_SEND_INTERVAL <= v6 - p2.lastInputSent then
		p1:flushInput(p2)
	end

	if not p2.hadDigHit and (p2.firstDigAt ~= nil and (v6 - p2.firstDigAt > 0.75 and p2.moundTarget < 1)) then
		p2.moundTarget = math.min(1, p2.moundTarget + p3 / 2.5)
	end

	p1:updateDomeMound(p2, p3)
	p1:updateDigAnimationSpeed(p2, p3)
	p1.bar:setProgress(p2.progress)
	p1:updateItemPosition(p2)

	if not (difficulty and p2.progress <= DIG_LOSE_THRESHOLD) then
		return
	end

	if isDigImpossible(difficulty) then
		Notification.new("You need a stronger shovel to dig this!", 3, "None", "Red")
	end

	p1:finish(false)
end
function v14.updateDigAnimationSpeed(p1, p2, p3) --[[ updateDigAnimationSpeed | Line: 1490 ]]

	p2.digAnimationSpeed = p2.digAnimationSpeed + (v1 - p2.digAnimationSpeed) * (1 - math.exp(-v2 * math.min(p3, 0.1)))

function v14.onDigInput(p1) --[[ onDigInput | Line: 1496 | Upvalues: DIG_CLICK_ENERGY_GAIN (copy), playSound (copy), DIG_WIN_THRESHOLD (copy) ]]
	local session = p1.session

	if not session or (session.phase ~= "minigame" or session.clickCredits < 1) then
		return nil
	end

	local difficulty = session.difficulty

	session.clickCredits = session.clickCredits - 1

	if session.firstDigAt == nil then
		session.firstDigAt = os.clock()
	end

	if difficulty then
		session.progress = math.min(1, session.progress + difficulty.clickPower)
	else
		session.pendingClicks = session.pendingClicks + 1
	end

	session.clickEnergy = math.min(1, session.clickEnergy + DIG_CLICK_ENERGY_GAIN)
	session.totalClicks = session.totalClicks + 1
	session.fovPunch = math.min(5, session.fovPunch + 1.15)
	p1.bar:kick()
	p1.bar:setProgress(session.progress)
	p1:updateItemPosition(session)
	playSound("Tick", {
		cleanupDelay = 2,
		volume = 0.2 + session.progress * 0.18,
		playbackSpeed = 1 + session.progress * 0.25 + math.random() * 0.1
	})

	if not (difficulty and DIG_WIN_THRESHOLD <= session.progress) then
		return
	end
